name: Tawheed Zubair
deck: Three Moradabad schools, two parks and 235 native and medicinal saplings. Five students in every school are Tree Monitors, and keeping the saplings alive is their job. Eighty-eight per cent of them made it.
description: Three Moradabad schools, two parks, 235 native and medicinal saplings, and five Tree Monitors per school whose job is keeping them alive. 88 per cent did.

aims.p: Fourteen of them led the sessions, the drives and the rally, on a small stipend as Youth Ambassadors rather than as volunteers on a Sunday.
Marginalised neighbourhoods carry the worst of the air and the water and get the least teaching about either. That is where the sessions went.
Five Tree Monitors per school own the watering and the checking. Survival is the deliverable here, not the planting photograph.

aims.h: Cheap enough for the next mohalla
aims.p: Posters, saplings, a rally and a stipend. Nothing in the model needs a budget the next neighbourhood cannot find.

did: Ran poster competitions, awareness sessions and plantation drives in three Moradabad schools
Planted in two parks with local youth — about forty saplings in one and seventy-two in the other
Held a youth-led awareness rally through the neighbourhood
Appointed five Tree Monitors in each school to water and check the saplings
Put fourteen Youth Ambassadors on a small stipend to lead the sessions themselves
holes: Three of the young people who ran this — Zaid, Ansh and Somya — gave testimonials in Hindi that survive only as broken text. They have to be taken again from the speakers before anyone puts them on a page.
The saplings add up to 232 across the five sites and to about 235 in the totals. The two do not meet.

frames.alt: Seven young people standing at a park gate holding hand-painted posters, the middle one lettered ECONOVA, powered by Swechha
